CORRECTION_read_this_first.what_was_wrong: The commit message that banked this file (845ddf3e) said the beta42 quadrature term 'needs checking' and implied it might not be applied to the suppression decisions below. That is WRONG. The term is present in _projected_landing_after_next_pulse and it fired on both records in realignments_suppressed.
CORRECTION_read_this_first.how_it_was_disproved: The function was executed against this file's own recorded inputs, on 2026-08-21. Pulse 11: d=0.2994, aim=24.545 deg, mpp=1.06 -> t=min(d,mpp)=0.2994, perpendicular=0.1244, overshoot=0.0271, hypot=0.127282, matching the recorded projected_landing_m of 0.1273. Pulse 12: d=0.2539, aim=29.977 deg -> perpendicular=0.1269, overshoot=0.0340, hypot=0.131330, matching the recorded 0.1313. Both reproduce to rounding.
CORRECTION_read_this_first.why_it_LOOKED_missing: perpendicular_miss_m and projected_landing_m sit close together here (0.1244 vs 0.1273) and that is CORRECT at this geometry, not a symptom of a dropped term. Because d < metres_per_pulse, travel collapses to t = d, so the overshoot term reduces to d*(1-cos(aim)) -- only 0.0271 m at 24.5 deg. The quadrature term is small here by construction. Closeness of those two numbers is never evidence that the term is absent.
CORRECTION_read_this_first.what_the_REAL_limitation_is: The guard is a SINGLE-PULSE lookahead. It correctly projected 0.1273 m for one more pulse and suppressed on that basis. The segment then fired TWO more pulses (12 and 13) and landed 0.16734 m out with the target behind it, stopping on target_requires_reverse_recovery. The guard answered the question it was asked; the question was one pulse short of what happened.
CORRECTION_read_this_first.do_NOT_change_the_guard_on_this: n = 1. The function's own docstring already records that measured next-pulse travel ran 0.30x to 1.16x of the remaining distance, so a multi-pulse projection would compound that spread. Two previous attempts to improve a re-aim heuristic on thin evidence (the vio_max_realignments divergence detector, v1 and v2) were each reviewed and reverted for being wrong in different ways. See CLAUDE.md.
CORRECTION_read_this_first.method_lesson: The claim was written into a commit message, which no doc-symbol check can reach -- check_doc_symbols.py validates names in docs, not prose in git history. Reproducing a recorded number by executing the shipped function against the recorded inputs takes one command and settles it.

safety_gates.name: stop_primitive_available
safety_gates.detail: Coordinator must expose async_stop_manual_motion().

safety_gates.name: ble_transport_required
safety_gates.detail: Real closed-loop motion requires the BLE transport for responsive telemetry; cloud/Wi-Fi lag is unsafe for guarded path execution. BLE must also report itself usable -- being selected for routing does not mean a command can be delivered.

safety_gates.name: ble_link_live
safety_gates.detail: Real motion requires a conservative BLE preflight -- a live client, an open dispatch gate, an empty command queue, and a recent outbound attempt. 'Usable' only means BLE is eligible for routing; it stays True while the command queue is gated and commands (including the mandatory stop that bounds a pulse) accumulate undelivered. The send path separately waits for confirmed queue start and GATT-write completion. See docs/pymammotion-ble-slot-leak-bug.md.

safety_gates.name: operator_confirmed_blades_off
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires confirm_blades_off=true.

safety_gates.name: operator_confirmed_clear_area
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires confirm_clear_area=true.

safety_gates.name: mower_reports_blades_off
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires blade state off and cutter RPM zero/unknown.

safety_gates.name: mower_ready
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires the mower to be ready/paused, not mowing or charging.

safety_gates.name: not_docked_or_charging
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires the mower to be off the dock and not charging.

safety_gates.name: live_map_position_available
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires live map-local mower position.

safety_gates.name: position_area_inside
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires AREA_INSIDE, TURN_AREA_INSIDE, or CHANNEL_AREA_OVERLAP and a nonzero known zone hash.

safety_gates.name: map_position_nonzero
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires nonzero map-local x/y coordinates.

safety_gates.name: segment_too_long
safety_gates.detail: Segment length is capped at 6.1 m by authorization, not by a measured reach limit; the longest segment ever executed is 4.0 m.

safety_gates.name: linear_budget_insufficient_for_segment
safety_gates.detail: 22 linear pulses reach about 6.60 m at a stall-tolerant 0.3 m/pulse, short of this segment.
